audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart read "Skill" for Levels 1-3 and Level 6 while the content layer read Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Malzahar. The page rendered two different answers to who wins each of those rows.
audit.why: Malzahar has no dash, no early CC beyond a 6s 900-range Q and no Voidlings until W is levelled, so Orianna's placed ball and passive-stacked autos own levels 1-3. At 6 Nether Grasp is a 700-range point-and-click suppression on a 140s rank-1 cooldown that converts any step-up into a jungler kill, so the row belongs to him.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side -> Orianna (7/10), phases[4].side -> Malzahar (4/10); the content win[0..2] and win[4] already hold those values, so the layers now agree.

audit.why: Spikes are accurately placed: Orianna's Lost Chapter/Q-max trade window early, Malzahar's level 6 Nether Grasp, first item neutral, and Orianna's five-man Shockwave late against his single-target R (80s at rank 3 vs her 80s at rank 3, but hers hits a clump).

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page states the two decisive kit interactions: Void Shift grants crowd-control immunity, so Shockwave does not displace him while it is intact; and Malefic Visions is a damage-over-time threshold threat that keeps ticking after you disengage.
audit.why: Riot's own passive text: massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity when he has not recently taken damage, lingering briefly after damage. Any chip - a Q graze or one passive auto - starts stripping it, which is why the ball on his approach path matters mechanically and not just as zoning. Malefic Visions (E, 11/10/9/8/7s, 650 range) is flagged execute in the kit and refreshes off his other casts.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now names the real numbers and tells you to land Q before committing R so the knockup does not hit a CC-immune target; dosFull[0].d and dosFull[2].d tie the chip damage to stripping Void Shift.
sources: brief enemyKit P Void Shift text

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and the packet flagged zero sequencing cues in the whole matchup.
audit.why: The field exists to hold real cooldowns. Nether Grasp is 140/110/80, Call of the Void 6s flat, Malefic Visions 11/10/9/8/7.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the rank-by-rank R cooldown and the 6s Q, plus the Void Shift sequencing rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text claimed clearing his voidlings stops his passive shield charging.
audit.why: Void Shift charges on Malzahar not having recently taken damage. Killing Voidlings does nothing to it; damaging Malzahar does.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to tie the strip to landing damage on Malzahar himself before you commit.
sources: brief enemyKit P Void Shift text

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Orianna

edits.before: Ball on the wave, autos on his face — your passive-stacked autos win level 1 against almost every mid. Place, don't throw.
edits.after: Ball on the wave, autos on his face — Malzahar has no dash, no CC and no Voidlings yet, so level 1 is a free chunk.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Orianna

edits.before: Q-W online: the classic chunk combo. Trade it on his last-hits and keep the ball where his approach must cross it.
edits.after: Q-W online and he cannot answer it: trade on his last-hit step, shove faster than he clears, and hold him off the wave.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Orianna

edits.before: E completes the kit: ball-on-self beats his engage, ball-on-wave farms, ball-on-him threatens. The chess match begins.
edits.after: E completes the kit and he still has no engage: ball-on-self blanks his 900-range Q poke while Q-W keeps him under tower.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Malzahar

edits.before: Shockwave online — your lane presence doubles without casting anything. Every wave he contests is a potential flip.
edits.after: Nether Grasp online: 700-range point-click suppression that hands his jungler the kill. Hold Flash, stop walking up.

edits.before: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: matchup-defining — Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Check it before every step-up. - E Command: Protect is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Nether Grasp: 140s at rank 1, 110s at 2, 80s at 3 — step up on its downtime and never while it reads up. - Call of the Void: 6s flat, and the silence is what opens his combo. - Void Shift: damage on Malzahar himself strips it, so land Q before you commit R or the knockup finds a CC-immune target.

edits.before: From Luden's you run rivers: shove the wave, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball on your jungler doubles every gank.
edits.after: From Luden's you run rivers: shove the wave, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the clump that contests. Protect-ball rides your jungler in and carries your R with him.

edits.before: Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: The ball on his approach means every step toward a last-hit crosses your Q-W, and that chip is also what keeps Void Shift from ever finishing charging.

edits.before: Ball on his farm path, Q-W the last-hit contact, auto-weave once, and recall the ball — three-second trades his combo math can't answer.
edits.after: Q is 7s at rank 1 and 3s maxed — trade it on his last-hit step, add the W slow field, weave one auto, then pull the ball home.

edits.before: Malzahar spends Nether Grasp early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Passive ramps on repeat hits — autos into Malzahar strip Void Shift and finish the chunk.

edits.before: That is Malzahar’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: The ball 815 range away is no E shield for 9s — his R window.

edits.before: Poking with the ball stranded at max range when his engage is up — an Orianna without her ball is a Doran's Ring with legs.
edits.after: Shockwave is 110s at rank 1 and it is your only answer to his grouped Nether Grasp — spending it on a wave sells the next fight.

edits.before: Ball on his farm path, Q-W the last-hit contact, auto-weave once, and recall the ball — three-second trades his combo math can't answer.
edits.after: Ball on his farm path, Q-W as he steps to last-hit, weave an auto to strip Void Shift, then pull the ball back before his 6s Q returns.

edits.before: Poking with the ball stranded at max range when his engage is up — an Orianna without her ball is a Doran's Ring with legs.
edits.after: Poking with the ball parked at max range while his R reads up — no E shield for 9s is the exact gap Nether Grasp is built to punish.

edits.before: Malzahar wins by landing Nether Grasp, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Malzahar wins by farming behind Voidlings until Nether Grasp and a jungler turn one step-up into a death.

edits.before: Carry through the ball — no champion controls teamfight space like Orianna; one Shockwave on three is a won game, and you decide when it happens.
edits.after: Carry through the ball: his R takes one carry, yours takes their clump — group early, shield your diver, and open the fight before he picks.

edits.before: If Malzahar gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Nether Grasp extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with Q-W clears and stay relevant through Shockwave threat.
edits.after: If Malzahar gets a kill his Malefic Visions clears your casters outright and he free-farms — give his 700-range R extra room and farm with Q-W. Two kills: stop stepping inside his 900-range Q and scale.

edits.before: Even after Ludens the fight is neutral because his E spread and Q silence trade with your poke; keep clearing his voidlings with W so his passive shield never charges before you commit.
edits.after: Even after Ludens the fight is neutral because his E spread and 6s Q silence trade with your poke; land damage on Malzahar himself, not his voidlings, so Void Shift is stripped before you commit R.

notes: Cross-layer chart disagreement found on rows 0,1,2,4: full-layer phases[N].side said Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill while content win[N] said Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Malzahar. The content layer matched the packet levelChart and is grounded in the kit, so the full layer was moved to match it. No paired win[N] edit is proposed because win[N] already holds the correct value on disk - a same-value edit would be a no-op. breakdown.wave and breakdown.late are structurally templated Orianna boilerplate but Malzahar gives nothing specific enough to ground a replacement without inventing, so they are left alone. Void Shift's CC immunity vs Shockwave is asserted from Riot's own passive text; whether the immunity beats a knockup specifically (vs merely a stun) is not stated in the kit file - see unverified.
